regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative regime: only Coal and Banks clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate (2/22 themes, 9% breadth), with Coal leading on momentum and Banks the only crowded eligible theme. Background is consistent with a mean-reverting tape: the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold here historically (gate_helps=false), relative momentum has rank-IC ~0, and past directional accuracy is weak (0.347 on 95 calls) — so leans are modest and conditional, not predictive.
emerging_watch: Watching for a CONFIRMED handoff from Coal toward any theme, most plausibly Banks given its challenger rank and full breadth — retire the watch if Coal re-accelerates to a fresh high while Banks lags by more than 3% over the next 5 sessions.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the sole leader with healthy trend-gate eligibility and above-threshold durability_bar (0.55). It is uncrowded (crowding_z 0.72, crowded=false) with rising breadth (0.6) and is the one-narrative leader. Momentum is a focus lens, not alpha, but the eligible + durable + uncrowded combination supports a humble relative overweight expressed as a conditional, not from rank alone.
evidence: durability_bar 0.55 (>0.5 threshold implied), hurst_tag mean-revert but breadth 0.6
theses.dissent: The tape is mean-reverting (gate_helps=false) and hurst_tag is mean-revert; Coal's momentum may whipsaw hard and the durability_bar at 0.55 is only just clearing — leadership could decay without a trend edge.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) closes below its 5-day-ago level while CSI 300 is flat or up.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only other eligible theme, with the strongest durability_bar (0.84) and full breadth (1.0), consistent with a durable, cohesive trend. The crowding flag (crowding_z 1.81, crowded=true) is a sizing caution, not a fade. Given the documented failure mode is fading the leader, I lean with the trend but mark low conviction because crowding argues for caution and the gate has no forward return edge here.
theses.dissent: Banks are the most crowded eligible theme; crowding is a size-down caution and historically marks tops in attention. The crowded flag plus a mean-reverting tape raises the risk of a sharp rotation out even if the trend currently holds.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) gives up all of its trailing 10-day gain before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
